Arm.description: One arm: a recipe with overrides, healed through a filler.

filler.description: The filler entry in the configuration the run is given.

overrides.description: Parameter overrides, `"<step>.<param>" = value`; `"<step>.constants"` selects a set.

recipe.description: A shipped recipe by name or a recipe file relative to this file.

spend_usd_per_call.description: What one filler call may cost; the ledger sums it.

MatrixImage.description: One image of the matrix: a corpus id with what the recipes need for it.

inputs.description: Recipe input bindings by input name: files relative to this file (a location, a mask).

overrides.description: Per-image parameter overrides, `"<step>.<param>" = value` (a prompt for this image).

Override.description: An override's value: what a step parameter takes.

corpus.description: The corpus manifest, relative to this file.

name.description: The lab's name; the protocol's must match.

protocol.description: The protocol, relative to this file; required, and its digest is recorded.

seed.description: The draw seed; the protocol's must match.
